name: Roads at Risk - Lower Township DEM
source: USGS 3DEP Bare Earth DEM Dynamic ImageServer
sourceDescription: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service, retrieved for the Roads at Risk municipal rollout.
processing: Exported from USGS 3DEP at municipal extent, masked to the Lower Township boundary, adaptively resampled to 12.2 ft pixels to keep the browser-delivered raster within operational size limits, and compressed as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
